freeze_evidence: iPad real-device Learn -> Practice -> Readiness flow passed

learn.micro_practice: short formative checks with immediate feedback

invariants.evidence_rule: Formative practice and readiness assessment evidence remain separate; do not mechanically merge them into one mastery score.
invariants.assessed_skill_rule: Each scored item has one assessed skill. supporting_skills do not automatically receive attempted/correct updates.
invariants.core_rule: Entrance10 and Specialized-Challenge never contribute to KNTT Core readiness or gate Core progression.
invariants.soft_mastery: Readiness recommends next action; it never blocks the next topic.

rollout_policy: Apply by topic/strand batch. Do not create per-card rollout PRs unless fixing a verified defect.
